cache.geocoder:
    class: Drupal\Core\Cache\CacheBackendInterface
    tags:
      - { name: cache.bin }
    factory: cache_factory:get
    arguments: [geocoder]

  geocoder.throttle:
    class: Drupal\geocoder\GeocoderThrottle
  Drupal\geocoder\GeocoderThrottleInterface: '@geocoder.throttle'
=== custom ===
services:
  _defaults:
    autoconfigure: true
  openculturas_openstreetmap.addressLookup:
    class: Drupal\openculturas_openstreetmap\AddressLookup
    autowire: true
  Drupal\openculturas_openstreetmap\AddressLookup: '@openculturas_openstreetmap.addressLookup'

  openculturas_openstreetmap.event_subscriber:
    class: Drupal\openculturas_openstreetmap\EventSubscriber\OpenculturasOpenStreetMapSubscriber
    autowire: true
    tags:
      - { name: event_subscriber }

  openculturas_openstreetmap.api_client:
    class: Drupal\openculturas_openstreetmap\OpenStreetMap\ApiClient
    autowire: true
  Drupal\openculturas_openstreetmap\OpenStreetMap\ApiClient: '@openculturas_openstreetmap.api_client'

  openculturas_openstreetmap.search:
    class: Drupal\openculturas_openstreetmap\PhotonSearch
    autowire: true
  Drupal\openculturas_openstreetmap\PhotonSearch: '@openculturas_openstreetmap.search'

  logger.channel.openculturas_openstreetmap:
    parent: logger.channel_base
    arguments: ['openculturas_openstreetmap']
=== geocoder version ===
            "name": "drupal/geocoder",
            "version": "4.37.0",
            "source": {

observation.command: sed -n '40,60p' /workspace/web/modules/contrib/geocoder/geocoder.services.yml; echo "=== custom ==="; cat /workspace/profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.services.yml; echo "=== geocoder version ==="; grep -A2 '"name": "drupal/geocoder"' /workspace/composer.lock | head
